Script.name: Sound Core
Script.script:
GUI.Sound = GUI.Sound or {} local Sound = GUI.Sound
Sound.TAG = "LuminariGUI" Sound.ORDER = {"chat", "low_health", "low_moves"} Sound.ALIASES = { chat = "chat", health = "low_health", low_health = "low_health", moves = "low_moves", movement = "low_moves", low_moves = "low_moves", } Sound.DEFAULTS = { masterEnabled = true, channels = { chat = { label = "Chat", enabled = false, file = "audio/chat_sound.mp3", volume = 100, cooldown = 0, priority = 40, }, low_health = { label = "Low health", enabled = false, file = "audio/health_warning.wav", volume = 75, cooldown = 30, priority = 80, threshold = 25, reset = 35, }, low_moves = { label = "Low movement", enabled = false, file = "audio/movement_warning.wav", volume = 65, cooldown = 30, priority = 60, threshold = 20, reset = 30, }, }, } Sound.lastPlayed = Sound.lastPlayed or {} Sound.latches = Sound.latches or {} Sound.lastFailure = Sound.lastFailure or {}
local function copyTable(value) if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end local result = {} for key, child in pairs(value) do result[key] = copyTable(child) end return result end
local function clamp(value, minimum, maximum, fallback) value = tonumber(value) if not value then return fallback end return math.max(minimum, math.min(maximum, value)) end
function Sound.channelName(name) if type(name) ~= "string" then return nil end return Sound.ALIASES[name:lower()] end
function Sound.normalizedSettings(saved) local settings = copyTable(Sound.DEFAULTS) if type(saved) ~= "table" then return settings end if type(saved.masterEnabled) == "boolean" then settings.masterEnabled = saved.masterEnabled end local savedChannels = type(saved.channels) == "table" and saved.channels or {} for name, defaults in pairs(settings.channels) do local source = savedChannels[name] if type(source) == "table" then if type(source.enabled) == "boolean" then defaults.enabled = source.enabled end if type(source.file) == "string" and source.file ~= "" then local normalized = Sound.normalizeRelativeFile and Sound.normalizeRelativeFile(source.file) if normalized then defaults.file = normalized end end defaults.volume = clamp(source.volume, 0, 100, defaults.volume) defaults.cooldown = clamp(source.cooldown, 0, 3600, defaults.cooldown) defaults.priority = clamp(source.priority, 1, 100, defaults.priority) if defaults.threshold then defaults.threshold = clamp(source.threshold, 1, 95, defaults.threshold) defaults.reset = clamp(source.reset, defaults.threshold + 5, 100, defaults.reset) end end end return settings end
function Sound.channel(name) local canonical = Sound.channelName(name) if not canonical then return nil, "unknown sound channel: " .. tostring(name) end Sound.settings = Sound.settings or Sound.normalizedSettings(nil) return Sound.settings.channels[canonical], canonical end
function Sound.syncLegacyChat() local chat = Sound.settings and Sound.settings.channels.chat if not chat then return end GUI.toggles = GUI.toggles or {} GUI.toggles.chatSound = chat.enabled if demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.config then demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled = chat.enabled demonnic.chat.config.soundFile = chat.file demonnic.chat.config.soundVolume = chat.volume demonnic.chat.config.soundCooldown = chat.cooldown end end
function Sound.save() GUI.toggles = GUI.toggles or {} GUI.toggles.sound = Sound.settings Sound.syncLegacyChat() if type(GUI.saveToggles) ~= "function" then return false, "toggle persistence is unavailable" end local ok, errorMessage = pcall(GUI.saveToggles) if not ok then GUI.debugError("SOUND/SAVE", errorMessage) return false, tostring(errorMessage) end return true end
function Sound.load() GUI.toggles = GUI.toggles or {} local saved = GUI.toggles.sound if type(saved) ~= "table" then local legacy = demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.config or {} saved = { channels = { chat = { enabled = GUI.toggles.chatSound == true or legacy.soundEnabled == true, file = legacy.soundFile, volume = legacy.soundVolume, cooldown = legacy.soundCooldown, }, }, } end Sound.settings = Sound.normalizedSettings(saved) Sound.latches = {} Sound.syncLegacyChat() Sound.save() GUI.debug("SOUND/LOAD", "sound settings loaded", Sound.settings) return Sound.settings end
function Sound.normalizeRelativeFile(fileName) if type(fileName) ~= "string" then return nil, "sound file must be a relative path" end local normalized = fileName:gsub("\\", "/"):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if normalized == "" or normalized:sub(1, 1) == "/" or normalized:match("^%a:/") or normalized:find("://", 1, true) then return nil, "sound file must stay inside the profile or LuminariGUI package" end for segment in normalized:gmatch("[^/]+") do if segment == ".." then return nil, "sound file cannot traverse outside its sound directory" end end return normalized end
function Sound.resolveFile(fileName) local normalized, pathError = Sound.normalizeRelativeFile(fileName) if not normalized then return nil, pathError end local home = getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") local candidates = { home .. "/LuminariGUI/" .. normalized, home .. "/" .. normalized, } for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do local handle = io.open(path, "rb") if handle then handle:close() return path end end return nil, "sound file not found: " .. normalized end
local function reportFailure(channel, message) if Sound.lastFailure[channel] ~= message then Sound.lastFailure[channel] = message GUI.debugError("SOUND/" .. channel, message) end end
function Sound.play(name, options) options = options or {} local config, channel = Sound.channel(name) if not config then return false, channel end local force = options.force == true if not force and Sound.settings.masterEnabled == false then return false, "master-disabled" end if not force and config.enabled == false then return false, "channel-disabled" end local now = tonumber(options.now) or os.time() local lastPlayed = Sound.lastPlayed[channel] if not force and lastPlayed and now - lastPlayed < config.cooldown then return false, "cooldown" end local path, pathError = Sound.resolveFile(config.file) if not path then reportFailure(channel, pathError) return false, pathError end local media = { name = path, volume = config.volume, key = "LuminariGUI." .. channel, tag = Sound.TAG, priority = config.priority, } local ok, result = pcall(playSoundFile, media) if not ok or result == false then local message = ok and "Mudlet rejected sound playback" or tostring(result) reportFailure(channel, message) return false, message end Sound.lastFailure[channel] = nil Sound.lastPlayed[channel] = now if channel == "chat" and demonnic and demonnic.chat then demonnic.chat.lastSoundTime = now end GUI.debug("SOUND/PLAY", "sound played", {channel = channel, media = media}) return true, path end
function Sound.checkThreshold(name, value, maximum) local config, channel = Sound.channel(name) value = tonumber(value) maximum = tonumber(maximum) if not config or not config.threshold or not value or not maximum or maximum <= 0 then return false, "invalid-threshold-data" end local percentage = math.max(0, math.min(100, (value / maximum) * 100)) if percentage >= config.reset then Sound.latches[channel] = false return false, "armed" end if percentage <= config.threshold then if Sound.latches[channel] then return false, "latched" end Sound.latches[channel] = true return Sound.play(channel) end return false, "unchanged" end
function Sound.stopAll() if type(stopSounds) ~= "function" then return false, "Mudlet stopSounds API is unavailable" end local ok, result = pcall(stopSounds, {tag = Sound.TAG}) if not ok or result == false then return false, ok and "Mudlet rejected stopSounds" or tostring(result) end return true end
